required_outputs.name: SOURCE_REGISTER.json
required_outputs.acceptance: Every admitted source has a stable identity, role, custody mode, and SHA-256.

required_outputs.name: ENGAGEMENT_TIMELINE.json
required_outputs.acceptance: Events are source-addressed and distinguish observed time from inferred order.

required_outputs.name: PROMISE_SCOPE_LEDGER.json
required_outputs.acceptance: Quoted commitments, assumptions, client expectations, and later changes remain distinct.

required_outputs.name: ACCEPTANCE_LEDGER.json
required_outputs.acceptance: Each deliverable has observed, missing, moved, or contradicted acceptance.

required_outputs.name: WORK_ECONOMICS_LEDGER.json
required_outputs.acceptance: Actual and estimated effort, paid and unpaid work, rework, and uncertainty are separated.

required_outputs.name: FAILURE_MECHANISM.md
required_outputs.acceptance: Actors, decisions, evidence gaps, and causal mechanism are named without retrospective invention.

required_outputs.name: COUNTERFACTUAL_POC.json
required_outputs.acceptance: The PoC uses historically available information and defines claim, limits, tests, pass, hold, and refusal.

required_outputs.name: IMPLEMENTATION_PACKAGES.json
required_outputs.acceptance: Each package has owner, inputs, outputs, interfaces, tests, dependencies, exclusions, and acceptance.

required_outputs.name: ECONOMIC_COMPARISON.json
required_outputs.acceptance: Actual and counterfactual economics disclose ranges, assumptions, and sensitivity.

required_outputs.name: ARCHITECT_CHALLENGE_LEDGER.json
required_outputs.acceptance: Every gate records PASS, HOLD, or REFUSE with evidence and repair condition.

required_outputs.name: SHADOW_PILOT_CONTRACT.md
required_outputs.acceptance: One live engagement can be shadowed without changing RedCat's ordinary client process.

prohibited_shortcuts: aggregate score that hides a failed gate
credential or protected-health-information transfer as a prerequisite
successful process exit treated as acceptance
